hero.subtitle: Private journeys through the wild heart of Sri Lanka — guides, accommodation and transport arranged by one company you can reach directly.

home.introTitle: One company for the whole journey — guides, stays and the road between them.
home.introBody: Nature Walks Sri Lanka was founded by Nandana Hewagamage so that travellers would have a single, trusted contact on the island. Every guide we send out is certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board, and we arrange the accommodation, the transport and the itinerary around them — from your first message to your last morning here.
home.servicesTitle: Everything a journey needs, from one place.
home.servicesBody: Come to us with dates and an idea of what you'd like to see. We put the rest together and stay reachable throughout the trip.

services.title: Certified guides
services.description: Naturalist, birding, trekking and cultural guides from our own team — every one of them certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board.

services.title: Accommodation
services.description: Hotels, boutique properties and eco lodges chosen to match your route and your budget, booked and confirmed by us.

services.title: Transport
services.description: Private vehicles with experienced drivers for the whole journey, plus airport transfers and any internal travel your route needs.

services.title: Your itinerary
services.description: A day-by-day route built around what you actually want to see, adjusted while you travel if the weather or the wildlife suggests otherwise.

home.guideBody: Nandana started out in wildlife conservation in 1990, working with village communities and university research teams on Sri Lanka's birds, plants and insects. He qualified as a national guide in 2002, and in 2017 founded Nature Walks Sri Lanka so travellers could have one company — and one guide — for the whole journey. He still leads tours himself.

nandana.introTitle: A lifetime spent walking through Sri Lanka.
nandana.whyTitle: A guiding company, not a booking desk.

whyPoints.title: Every guide certified
whyPoints.description: All Nature Walks Sri Lanka guides are certified by the Sri Lanka Tourism Board — you are never handed to an unlicensed freelancer for a leg of the trip.

whyPoints.title: Field-trained, not scripted
whyPoints.description: Our guiding grew out of wildlife conservation fieldwork rather than a tour-desk script, and Nandana still trains and leads the team himself.

whyPoints.title: One company, one journey
whyPoints.description: Guides, accommodation and transport all come from us, so there is one number to call for anything — before you arrive and while you're here.

sriLanka.title: Rainforest, highland and coast — closer together than you'd expect.
sriLanka.body: From Wilpattu's dry-zone leopard country to Sinharaja's endemic-rich rainforest canopy, from Kandy's hill temples to the reef off Trincomalee, Sri Lanka compresses a continent's worth of habitat into a single island.

conservation.title: Guiding rooted in fieldwork, not just hospitality.
conservation.quote: Nandana began his career with Sri Lanka's Department of Wildlife Conservation and remains a member of the Field Ornithology Group of the University of Colombo — conservation isn't a footnote to our tours, it's where the guiding started.
